image_description: A chestnut horse (sorrel) wearing racing tack, including a saddle cloth with the number 10, being held by a handler in a blue jacket. A jockey in white and turquoise silks with a blue helmet is mounted on the horse. The background shows a grassy paddock area with wooden fences, birch trees, and other horses and people in the distance. There is a watermark text '© Josefine Stenudd' in the top left corner.
